name: openframe-studio
description: OpenFrame Studio — local-first desktop filmmaking studio (Tauri v2 + React + Rust + SQLite).

scripts.bundle: npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --workspace apps/desktop run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
